text: Both extracts load into pandas as DataFrames. Printing shape first gives a baseline row count to compare against after every cleaning step.
Drop duplicates removes exact row repeats, solving the duplicate export problem from the customer extract directly. Comparing the row count before and after shows exactly how many rows got removed.
A few rows arrived with a blank CustomerSegment. fillna replaces those missing values with Individual, Thornbury's documented default for a segment that didn't come through cleanly.

Str dot strip removes the stray whitespace from the spreadsheet review pass, and str dot title normalizes capitalization so canada and Canada both become Canada. Then dropna with a subset removes only the rows missing a LineTotal, nothing else.
With both extracts cleaned, next lesson joins them together with pd dot merge.
